description: Give the sidecar's best-effort narration push a dedicated 2s idle-wait so a busy orchestrator pane can no longer stall the supervisor loop for the full 30s.

userStories.title: Decouple sidecar narration push from the 30s idle-wait deadline
userStories.description: As the sidecar supervisor loop, I need makeNotifyOrchestrator's best-effort narration push to wait at most a short dedicated idle-timeout before sending anyway to a busy orchestrator pane, so a mid-turn orchestrator can no longer block the outer loop and its in-memory merge-watch timers for up to 30s per narration line.
acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated NARRATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS === 2_000 is defined and exported from the dispatch module (src/tmux/dispatch.ts) and is strictly less than the unchanged IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS === 30_000. [oracle: bun test test/tmux/dispatch-timeouts.test.ts]

IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS stays 30_000 so the one-shot CLI thin-proxy waits (issue/review/spec) and the orch-recycle-watch process keep the full 30s; no other of the five sendKeysVerified call sites passes idleTimeoutMs. [oracle: bun test test/tmux/dispatch-timeouts.test.ts]

makeNotifyOrchestrator (src/supervisor/host.ts) passes idleTimeoutMs: NARRATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS in its sendKeysVerified options object and nothing else about the call changes (no touch to the sync/sleepFn contract or the send-anyway-on-timeout fallback). [oracle: grep -q 'idleTimeoutMs' src/supervisor/host.ts]

With a capturePaneFn injected to always report a busy (never-idle) pane and a sleepFn that accumulates slept ms, makeNotifyOrchestrator's narration push accumulates at most ~2_000 ms of wait (bounded by NARRATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS, not 30_000) before firing the send-anyway fallback. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/narration-idle-timeout.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
The full quality spine passes. [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Pure wiring, no behavior change beyond the shorter narration wait. Files: src/tmux/dispatch.ts (add+export NARRATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000 next to IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS at dispatch.ts:254; leave IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS untouched), src/supervisor/host.ts (makeNotifyOrchestrator at host.ts:322, sendKeysVerified call at host.ts:331 -> add idleTimeoutMs: NARRATION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS to the options object). sendKeysVerified already destructures idleTimeoutMs = IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS (dispatch.ts:528) and threads it into waitForIdlePane (dispatch.ts:405-406/555), so this is wiring only. GOTCHA: do NOT blanket-lower the shared IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS constant; the other four call sites (issue.ts:185, review.ts:183, spec.ts:218, orch-recycle-watch.ts:417 as one-shot/separate-process waits) legitimately want the full 30s. Behavioral test seam: makeNotifyOrchestrator takes spawnFn + capturePaneFn; inject a busy-pane capturePaneFn and a sleepFn that sums slept ms (sendKeysVerified accepts sleepFn) to assert the total wait is bounded by ~2_000 ms. Narration is best-effort and merge-watch polls in seconds over an up-to-4h window, so the shorter wait cannot lose a merge. Existing dispatch tests live at test/dispatch.test.ts and must stay green (~129 tests); the two new oracle test files (test/tmux/dispatch-timeouts.test.ts, test/supervisor/narration-idle-timeout.test.ts) are created by this story. SIDECAR-EXECUTED REBUILD after ship: bash scripts/build-release.sh --install then restart cam sidecar (host.ts + dispatch.ts run inside the sidecar). Same class as the CAM-103 outer-loop-blocking concern. grep scripts/cam/patterns.md for 'idle' / 'narration' / 'dispatch' before coding.
